summary: Configured node1 to use America/Toronto. The setting persisted across a safe reboot, and the node returned healthy with synchronized time.
actions_performed: Changed the timezone from America/New_York to America/Toronto using timedatectl.
Verified /etc/localtime matches the America/Toronto zoneinfo file.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified the system recovered and America/Toronto persisted after restart.

evidence.summary: The configuration command succeeded; direct checks before and after reboot showed Time zone: America/Toronto and a matching /etc/localtime target.

Healthy baseline boot ID 151c4aa9-9e81-4a32-9c22-08c5c441403a was captured, reboot acknowledgement returned, post-reboot boot ID changed to 921168a3-e848-4e6f-b0e4-28b835bddbaa, and the system recovered running with D-Bus active, NTP synchronized, and the configured timezone intact.
